---
title: "D74 cutover runbooks"
description: "Order, commands, rollback pins and smoke for each app cutover to a Cloudflare Worker."
---

Cutovers run in this order: lowest risk first. Marketing page groups flip through the gateway instead (see the gateway Worker page). Each section is the whole runbook for one app; the linked packet has the full binding, secret and variable names.

## Web apex pin

Full rollback for the apex `tuturuuu.com` (Vercel project `platform`, apps/web): `dpl_FZuaw8J2RRS3ust79agjwyKo2AAf` (source d209d72b). The current production deployment is `dpl_9NxJS4nsCaYZwEjSWe2bJwj2Hjdk` (prebuilt from a7826c1f). Pins read 9 Nov 23:40.

## Common steps

1. Record the source SHA, the sealed artifact (CI run id) and the Vercel rollback pin below.
2. Download the artifact: `gh run download <run-id> -R tutur3u/platform -n <artifact-name> -D /tmp/<app>-cutover`.
   Take the run id from a run on the production ref (`main`) at the accepted source SHA, and verify the run's head SHA. Never take an artifact by name alone: a name can match a pull-request run.
3. Provision the secret names from the packet on the Worker, then deploy the artifact config route-free: `bunx wrangler deploy --config /tmp/<app>-cutover/dist/server/wrangler.json --name <worker>` (no route yet).
4. Smoke the Worker on its own hostname before any route change: `node scripts/cutover-smoke.mjs <app> https://<worker-hostname>`.
5. Attach the route or custom domain for the host (proxied, in front of the still-valid Vercel origin where possible).
6. Re-run the smoke on the public host and watch for 5 minutes: no 5xx, login renders, entry route as expected.
7. Rollback on any 5xx above 1% for 5 minutes, a wrong redirect or a broken login: remove the route or repoint the DNS record to the Vercel pin. Never rebuild on the rollback path. No data or migration is involved.

## Not cut over tonight

- playground: no Vercel deployment found; staff-only app, routes attach at its own hostname when wanted.
- colab: already on Cloudflare; Start/Void port is a separate change.
- parley: already on Cloudflare (OpenNext).
- contacts: stays on Vercel (a client uses it daily); its conversion needs its own rehearsed rollback.
- mastermind: held by the wave-2 security hold.
- learn, chat, infrastructure, mind, hive: sources merged; packets exist but production artifact jobs and Vercel pins are still to capture.
